Muted peach-rose inner robe and cool pale celadon silk outer sleeves, fine small white floral embroidery, warm ivory collar, discreet jade waist pendant. One hand rests lightly on opposite wrist at waist, gentle three-quarter stance. Noble adult woman, no childish styling or exaggerated glamour.
characters.pose: Show a restrained WALKING-TO-A-STOP moment moving toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT. One foot steps forward clearly, the trailing foot stays behind, shifting body weight and creating an asymmetric hemline. Head turns slightly back toward the viewer, long side hair strands and a loose sash trailing gently to the left. Near hand lightly gathers a small amount of the outer skirt at the side of her HIP, revealing the shoe without exposing legs. Other arm hangs slightly BACK behind the torso, relaxed fingers visible. Natural gentle movement, not dancing or fashion runway. No clasped hands.
